method: Public YouTube pages in an isolated in-app browser tab. Playback paused and sampled at approximately opening, midpoint and ending using player seek keys. Rounded public view counts captured from watch page or YouTube search results. No private account analytics. Final two references were independently sampled in an isolated, unsigned-in headless Chromium public session and screenshots were saved; media bytes were not downloaded as production assets.
limitations: These are three-frame audits, not complete watches.
Audio remained muted and was not assessed; exact songs, BPM, beat synchronization and speech pace are not verified.
Sampling cannot establish cut frequency or retention.
View counts are time-sensitive rounded display values, not earnings, target-country fit or causal proof.
No footage or music reuse permission is inferred.
The lower-view football example is an illustrative counterexample, not a matched statistical control; upload age, audience and distribution differ.
